items.title: War in the Middle East could last a month, Trump says
items.description: Fresh explosions rock Tehran as Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu vows to intensify air strikes. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Two Liberals cross the floor in support of Hanson censure motion
items.description: Liberals Paul Scarr and Andrew McLachlan have crossed the floor of the Senate to support the government's censure motion against Pauline Hanson. Follow live.

items.title: Police watchdog issues extraordinary apology to family violence victim
items.description: IBAC's public apology to Jana Katerinskaja is a sharp reminder of the struggle for accountability victims of police-perpetrated family violence too often face.

items.title: The Trump insult that pushed Marjorie Taylor Greene over the edge and out of MAGA
items.description: Many of Donald Trump's supporters wanted to send those implicated in Jeffrey Epstein's sex trafficking ring "off to the gallows", but then the president changed his mind about releasing the files. What followed was an unusual political manoeuvre, acts of immense bravery by survivors and a backflip by the president of the United States.

items.title: 'A tax on households': Economists warn Middle East war to spike oil
items.description: The average household could see $14 added to their weekly petrol bill, a prominent economist has warned. While oil prices have already spiked, analysts are hopeful the conflict will be short-lived, limiting the fallout.

items.title: Live: Iran strikes rattle markets, oil price jumps 9pc
items.description: Global markets are braced for the fallout from the outbreak of war in the Middle East, with the ASX down in early trade but gains for energy stocks limiting the losses. Follow today's events on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: 'Traumatised' patients left out of gynaecologist Simon Gordon review
items.description: Women who had surgery for "severe" endometriosis despite pathology showing little trace of the disease are angry and upset that Epworth Hospital has not invited them to participate in an external review.

items.title: 'They basically stole the word': Farmers fight to reclaim 'milk'
items.description: Australian dairy farmers say the plant-based drinks industry has "stolen" the word milk, and they are pointing to a recent court ruling as an opportunity to claim it back.

items.title: Father who fell to his death zip-lining on 'bucket list' trip, inquest hears
items.description: A coronial inquest into the 2019 death of 50-year-old Dean Sanderson has heard the mining project manager was visiting Far North Queensland with his wife, after "a pretty terrible health situation".

items.title: NT administrator 'very sorry' for 'trigger' posts but also 'not sorry'
items.description: New NT Administrator David Connolly has extended invitations to groups which say they will not work with him, in an attempt to repair divisions caused by controversial past social media posts.

items.title: CEO says F1 weekend will run without issue despite Middle East conflict
items.description: Formula 1's season opener is expected to go ahead without a hitch this weekend in Melbourne, after conflict in the Middle East forced a change in travel plans for many teams.

items.title: Catherine O'Hara wins posthumous Actor award for The Studio
items.description: The Studio co-creator Seth Rogen accepted the award on O'Hara's behalf, following the death of the comedy legend in January this year.

items.title: Minister denies 'negligence on his watch' after snap review into hospitals
items.description: The review comes after a fungal infection cluster at a transplant ward at Sydney's Royal Prince Alfred Hospital linked to two deaths.

items.title: Emergency powers invoked as flood risk rises across Central Australia
items.description: An emergency has been declared as as a tropical low brings heavy rain, rising river levels and flooding risks to Central Australia and the Barkly region.

items.title: 'Haven't looked back': How Max's move to the country changed his life
items.description: Moving to the country might sound idyllic to overstimulated and stressed-out city dwellers, but for Max and Courtney, it took some soul-searching to find their purpose and a place to really call home.

items.title: Simple and tasty recipes for cosy autumn nights in
items.description: We’ve crunched the numbers and these are five of your favourite ever autumn recipes to look forward to this season.

items.title: History quiz: Can you work your way backward through these questions?
items.description: Where was MH370 heading, which Australian won our first Oscar and what was the world's first vampire movie?

items.title: Men claiming to be council contractors chop Bondi tree
items.description: Residents of a quiet street in Bondi are split after men wearing high-vis and wielding chainsaws allegedly illegally destroyed a tree.

items.title: Meat exporter facing $800k weekly losses over Middle East shutdown
items.description: A meat exporter among those caught in the fallout of the US-Israeli bombing of Iran says his business will have to freeze hundreds of thousands of dollars' worth of produce.

items.title: 26-year-old arrested after 'harmless guy' dies following campground fight
items.description: Police have arrested a 26-year-old man in northern New South Wales after the death of a 33-year-old man following an alleged assault at a campground near Ebor.

items.title: Inquest told details of man believed to be last to see Sydney woman alive
items.description: An inquest has heard Sydney woman Jessica Zrinski went missing in November 2022 after meeting a man she did not know in a pub car park.

items.title: SA Labor pledges OSHC expansion as Liberals support free school concept
items.description: Labor has announced a plan for further funding to expand out of school hours care, while the Liberal Party now supports the concept of free schools and is demanding a freight bypass to get trucks off city roads.

items.title: V'landys maintains there's life left in NRL Las Vegas party
items.description: ARL Commission chair Peter V'Landys is adamant Las Vegas can remain a success beyond 2027 and insists fans will continue turning up once their team returns for a second time.

items.title: Medvedev among tennis stars stranded in Dubai after air strikes
items.description: Daniil Medvedev says he is unsure when he will be able to leave Dubai after the exchange of air strikes between the US, Israel and Iran shut down the UAE airport.

items.title: Women carry bulk of the mental load, but men are active in one stage
items.description: While research has found mothers do more in all four stages of cognitive labour, there was one stage where men were more active than others.
